ai_summary.text:
インソースは社会人向け研修・人材育成のプラットフォーム企業。企業・官公庁向けの階層別研修・DX研修の提供と、eラーニングシステム「Leaf」、ITスキル研修「Togurol」を展開する研修業界のリーディングカンパニー。

売上145億円（前年比+16.3%）と二桁増収。営業利益60億円（営業利益率41.2%）、純利益41億円。41%超の驚異的な営業利益率はコンテンツ型ビジネスのスケーラビリティを反映。ROE33.1%と極めて高い資本効率。

自己資本比率77.3%、財務健全性スコア100点と最高評価の財務。営業CF44億円、FCF42億円とほぼ全額がFCFとして残る。EPS49円に対しPER19.6倍、配当25円。リスキリング・DX人材育成は国策的な推進テーマであり、研修コンテンツの蓄積とデジタル配信のプラットフォームが強固な競争優位を形成している。なお、EPS49.2円、PER19.6倍、1株当たり配当金25.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: Insource is a platform company for corporate training and human resource development. It is a leading company in the training industry that provides hierarchical training and DX training for companies and government agencies, and develops the e-learning system "Leaf" and IT skill training "Togurol."  Revenue is  14.5 billion (up 16.3% year-on-year), a double-digit increase. Operating profit is  6.0 billion (operating profit margin of 41.2%) and net profit is  4.1 billion. The phenomenal operating profit margin of over 41% reflects the scalability of the content-based business. Extremely high capital efficiency with ROE of 33.1%.  Equity ratio is 77.3% and financial soundness score is 100 points, the highest rating. Operating CF is  4.4 billion and FCF is  4.2 billion, with almost all of it remaining as FCF. EPS is  49, with a PER of 19.6x and a dividend of  25. Reskilling and DX human resource development are national policy promotion themes, and the accumulation of training content and the digital distribution platform form a strong competitive advantage. EPS is  49.2, PER is 19.6x, and dividend per share is  25.0, and the company is promoting management that balances shareholder returns and corporate value enhancement.
